comparability: One warmed JVM per full matrix; candidate3 compared with the retained earlier baseline run on the same host and settings. There is no randomized cross-process replication for this final M3 candidate. Raw within-process sample spread is included; ratios are observed medians, not confidence intervals.

construction_observations.scope: Construction includes fixture reference arrays and wrapper creation and first-use class loading; GC sampled used heap is not retained owner size.

process.scope: Whole JVM including warmups, oracle verification, fixture construction and GC; totals do not isolate traversal and can hide opposing workload effects.
